name: Iain Bryan
career_history: Sales Director - Hyperscale at AtlasEdge, 5/2024 to present; Global Key Account Director at Alibaba Cloud, 5/2021 to 5/2024; Enterprise Account Manager at Huawei Technologies, 4/2019 to 5/2021; Corporate Account Manager at Whitbread, 5/2014 to 4/2019; Account Director at SSS Managed Services, 5/2012 to 5/2014; Senior Account Manager at BBC Worldwide and Subsideries, 12/2008 to 5/2012; Sales Executive at HEXUS, 6/2008 to 12/2008; Sales Executive at Future Publishing, 3/2006 to 6/2008; Sales Assistant at Orange, 9/2004 to 3/2006
education: A levels, King Edwards VI Lichfield, 1997 to 2004
biography: As a Global Key Account Director at Alibaba Cloud, I am responsible for managing and growing the largest blue-chip businesses across the Nordics and UKI regions. I have over 15 years of experience in sales and more recently within the cloud, telecoms, and IT industry, with a proven track record of delivering results and exceeding targets. I have a strong passion and ambition for driving new business, creating strategic business plans, and generating meaningful growth for my clients and my company. I have a deep understanding of the cloud services market and key technologies, such as WIFI, data-com, and network energy, that enable digital transformation and innovation. I also have a consultative approach, a complex sales model, and a collaborative mindset, which allow me to work with the end users, the channel, the solution managers, and the international teams effectively. I am proud to be a part of Alibaba Cloud, the leading cloud service provider in the world, and to contribute to its mission of making it easy to do business anywhere.
